lead_raw_text:
The cubic phase Ho24Ga12Mo12 (reduced formula Ho2GaMo, space group F-43m, No. 216) has 48 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies 12-coordinate close-packed-like local arrangements for all three elements: Ga and Mo are each surrounded by 8 Ho and 4 of the other element, while Ho is coordinated by 4 Ga and 8 Mo. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 48 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among Ho-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and edge sharing between Ga- and Mo-centered polyhedra.
